svg.title: 魔法存储 — 远行队传送器，第二稿
svg.desc: Original 1×1 fixed-orientation caravan teleporter. A deep-blue continuous spiral curls into a dark transfer aperture, surrounded by a thin metal collar on a low pearl-grey rounded-square plinth. Restrained RGB(197,229,245) accents; uniform pure-black outer contour.
Approved continuous spiral geometry and aperture clipping retained; flatter collar and simplified casing. Review only.
